events.text:
I deployed the payment routes to the live centre, but T-122 is blocked again: real Dodo payments still can't reach the centre, because the endpoint as you approved it wouldn't have worked.

**What's live now:**
- The 0018 migration is applied to the live database.
- The centre Worker is deployed (version `ec4b49cd`).
- The Worker holds the Dodo webhook secret we already had. It was stored without printing it.

**Live check:** I sent signed test events to https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/hooks/dodo for test attendee 2. A failed payment didn't grant the seat. A successful payment made them VIP, shown in the admin and on the attendee's own centre page. Sending the same event again changed nothing. A full refund put them back to free, so the live data is as it was.

**Why I didn't add the Dodo endpoint:** Dodo gives every webhook endpoint its own new signing secret. The secret we have belongs to the disabled `staging.usetantra.com` endpoint. A new endpoint would sign with a secret the centre doesn't have, so every real payment would be rejected. Storing a different secret than the one you approved goes beyond your yes, so I stopped there.

**Decision for you:** Can I add `/hooks/dodo` as a Dodo webhook endpoint for payment succeeded, failed and cancelled plus refund succeeded, and store the secret Dodo creates for it in the centre? `api.usetantra.com` would stay untouched. The centre would keep the current secret too so the Next app's forward still works, which needs a small code change to accept both. Yes or no?

No repo files changed, so there was nothing to commit. Your note W-8e29fdf672 is acknowledged.
